items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Professor Cook is promoting it... He fascinated me... They all knew one another. They all had been in vaudeville, and then they tried to promote. So he'd call you when you'd go to Chicago.

ctx.x: Yeah! On the IC. And we'd meet at Canal Street, and I went... Lee said, "We've got a chance to go to Chicago." I'm working with that band. He said, "We've got a chance to go to Chicago. Professor Cook is promoting it."
